windowTitle: Serial integration stage 7 precondition - canonical main now carries the exact serial source SHA
scope: Record that PR #690 merged the serial integration branch into canonical main via a merge commit, with the branch CI green and the exact branch SHA an ancestor of main, so a Candidate can be built from the same SHA.

findings.fact: PR #690 (head codex/tke-serial-integration, head SHA cddd8b02) merged into main as merge commit 9ce3dc59. Checks: validate passed in 10m36s; dependency-review passed. mergeStateStatus was CLEAN and mergeable MERGEABLE before merge.
findings.consequence: Canonical main now contains the exact serial source SHA cddd8b02, so the Build OPL Cloud Candidate workflow can be dispatched with product_sha=cddd8b02.

findings.fact: build-opl-cloud-candidate.yml job guard is `github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.actor == github.repository_owner && github.triggering_actor == github.repository_owner`. The repository owner is the user account gaofeng21cn; the authenticated operator is RenDeHuang (write collaborator, not the owner). Historical successful Candidate runs were all dispatched by gaofeng21cn. Confirmed by dispatch attempt: run 36650150455 (main, product_sha=2dcd7e81) was dispatched by RenDeHuang and completed 'skipped' in 2s, because the candidate job guard requires github.actor == github.repository_owner.
findings.consequence: Dispatching the Candidate build requires the repository-owner identity (gaofeng21cn); a write-collaborator dispatch is skipped, not run. This is the owner/authorized-actor external condition for Stage 7, not a source defect.

notRun: Candidate build (requires the repository-owner dispatcher gaofeng21cn).
Instance deployment, provider action, production readback.
Real route activation (I07), publisher model-config readback (I08) and the typed Serve->Fabric application-execution boundary (I06), each pending its frozen external contract.
claimBoundary: This receipt claims the serial integration source is merged into canonical main at an exact SHA with green CI. It does not claim a Candidate image, Instance deployment, production acceptance or completion of the still-blocked I06/I07/I08 items.
